decision: Who is Thapal for: your family and companies only, or a public product?
recommendation_agreed: Build for your own family and companies through phase 3, then decide. A public product changes privacy scale, support, pricing and liability

decision: Which entities and standards come first for statutory output?
recommendation_agreed: India only. Individuals, HUFs, private companies and LLPs. Indian accounting standards first; Ind AS only if a company needs it

decision: Prepare filings, or also submit them?
recommendation_agreed: Prepare everything; submit nothing directly until phase 5, then evaluate each intermediary separately

decision: Should anything post without confirmation?
recommendation_agreed: Not until accuracy is proven. Then the graduated autopilot in the automation policy, with a bar of 99.5% on amounts and dates and 97% on category over 200 real rows per issuer

decision: Permission matrix and two-person thresholds
recommendation_agreed: Adopt the matrix in Roles. Owner approval for journals above ₹50,000 per company; two approvals to reopen a month, change history in bulk or grant professional access

decision: Which paid services are acceptable?
recommendation_agreed: Approve inbound email, document reading and AI model usage, and storage now, under a monthly spending cap. Defer licensed price feeds and filing intermediaries to phase 5

decision: Which report layouts come first?
recommendation_agreed: Schedule III balance sheet and profit and loss, GST and TDS workings, bank reconciliation, net worth statement, personal tax computation

decision: What history is available from 1 April 2026?
recommendation_agreed: KK lists every account and the statements held; batch 9 flags the gaps

decision: UIX approval
recommendation_agreed: Agreed 9 Nov 2026: Signature Flow (Concept 06) is the visual target. Still to verify: final logo artwork, real-device checks

decision: Native iPhone app?
recommendation_agreed: Stay a web app through phase 4; add a thin native wrapper in phase 5 for the share sheet and camera

decision: AI model provider for reading documents and Ask
recommendation_agreed: One provider with no-training terms and India-region hosting where offered; keep the layer swappable

decision: Terms for professionals using Thapal
recommendation_agreed: A short engagement note covering scope, data access, liability and who certifies what

decision: Payroll scope
recommendation_agreed: Import salary registers in phase 3; revisit running payroll after phase 4

decision: Live balances: email alerts only, or also RBI's Account Aggregator (read-only, consent-based)?
recommendation_agreed: Email alerts now. Revisit Account Aggregator after phase 1 if alerts miss too much; it is a form of bank linking

decision: Email intake: forwarding rules to a Thapal address, or direct read access to your Gmail?
recommendation_agreed: Both: forwarding rules from phase 1, then a direct read-only connection once Google's verification and security assessment pass; apply in phase 0

decision: What may the AI rules watch apply without you?
recommendation_agreed: Only due-date extensions and form versions with no field changes. Everything else waits for your tap, with your CA as backup approver

decision: Who approves your own expense claims to the companies and trusts?
recommendation_agreed: You, plus a second approver (your CA or a finance head) for claims above an amount you set, to strengthen the audit trail

decision: Spending limits per entity (hotel per night, meals per day)
recommendation_agreed: Set them after three months of real data; they flag, never block

decision: Which filings need a professional's approval before they go out?
recommendation_agreed: Adopt the table in Tax and compliance: professionals sign audit reports and certifications; you approve the rest, with your CA reviewing quarterly

decision: Recovery targets: how much data loss and downtime is acceptable?
recommendation_agreed: At most 15 minutes of data and 4 hours of downtime, a quarterly restore drill, and a monthly full export to storage you choose

decision: Upload links: a plain link, or a one-time code before uploading?
recommendation_agreed: A one-time code for links open longer than 7 days; a plain link for short monthly requests

decision: What does the family view show for adult members by default?
recommendation_agreed: Only what each adult chooses to share; you manage minors and anyone who asks you to

decision: Who certifies contractor bills before payment?
recommendation_agreed: Your engineer or architect for running bills above an amount you set; you approve the payment

decision: Below what cost is an item expensed rather than registered as an asset?
recommendation_agreed: Set the limit per entity with your CA; cheaper items can still be labelled and verified as minor assets

decision: Maintenance tickets: run them in Thapal, or link to Thapal Maintenance where it already runs?
recommendation_agreed: Link where Thapal already handles maintenance, so staff use one system; Thapal keeps the cost, warranty, insurance and accounting side

decision: Tenants: their own login now, or links only?
recommendation_agreed: Links only at first (rent receipts, maintenance requests, documents); a tenant login later if needed

decision: How soon should Thapal lock and ask for Face ID again?
recommendation_agreed: After 5 idle minutes on phones and 15 on computers; always before approvals, exports and access changes

decision: Which mailboxes connect first?
recommendation_agreed: Your personal Gmail and the mailboxes of the two entities with the most mail; add the rest after a month

decision: Which further suggestions to adopt now?
recommendation_agreed: Adopted by KK on 8 November: all fourteen, in the phases shown in Added features

decision: What may the 4-digit PIN do?
recommendation_agreed: Open the app and do everyday work; approvals, exports, access changes and filings above your limit still need Face ID, fingerprint or a passkey

decision: Which Money Map layout opens first?
recommendation_agreed: Mind map on iPad and computer, one level at a time on iPhone; switch to Flow or Network at any time

decision: Should every expense report be the one Detailed Expenditure Statement with saved presets?
recommendation_agreed: Yes: one engine and one format, with the filters printed on it; only claims, settlements, reconciliations and registers keep their own layout

decision: Which finance statuses does a trip use?
recommendation_agreed: The merged eight: Not started, Recording expenses, Awaiting documents, Reconciling, Settlement pending, Ready to close, Financially closed, Reopened with approval

decision: Who may close or reopen a trip's finances?
recommendation_agreed: The owner of the paying entity, with Face ID and a reason, visible to the CA in history; closing with open balances needs the same approval

decision: How do Apple, Google and Outlook calendars connect?
recommendation_agreed: Start with a private, revocable subscription link per workspace with privacy titles; add two-way Google and Outlook sync in phase 5

decision: Which notification channels, in what order?
recommendation_agreed: In-app and email from the start, then push (iPhone needs Thapal on the Home Screen); WhatsApp and SMS in phase 5, after approvals and with per-message cost

decision: Voice languages and audio
recommendation_agreed: English first; Tamil and Hindi through a paid speech service once each passes the 200-phrase test; audio deleted after transcription

decision: Permanent ID format
recommendation_agreed: Readable prefixes (TRP-, AST-, PRP-, EXP-, CLM-, DES-) with a running number, never reused; company display codes kept beside them

decision: Reimbursement policy defaults
recommendation_agreed: None until each entity sets its own category limits, per-diem and mileage rates; breaches flagged, never blocked

decision: Recovery targets
recommendation_agreed: Adopt at most 15 minutes of lost data and 4 hours to recover, once the cost of point-in-time recovery and a separate document backup is confirmed; restore drills every quarter

decision: Market prices
recommendation_agreed: End-of-day closing prices and daily NAVs by default; add a licensed live feed only if you want intraday values

decision: Asset capitalisation threshold
recommendation_agreed: Each entity sets its own in its accounting policy; Thapal proposes, and items below it are expensed

decision: Expense approval thresholds
recommendation_agreed: Set by you per entity; companies add a second approver above a set amount

decision: Contractor bill certification
recommendation_agreed: Bills above a set amount need a named certifier, such as the site engineer, before payment is proposed

decision: Group consolidation scope
recommendation_agreed: You and your CA choose which entities form each group view and how part-owned ones count; intercompany balances are always eliminated

decision: Requirement IDs and register
recommendation_agreed: Adopt REQ-area-number IDs, never reused, with the register kept as a sheet updated after every development batch

decision: Production typeface
recommendation_agreed: Manrope, free under the SIL Open Font Licence, with Noto Sans Tamil and Noto Sans Devanagari for Tamil and Hindi

decision: iPhone Add button colour
recommendation_agreed: Deep green #223B35, as in the tokens and the computer layout; treat the blue in the iPhone capture as a prototype slip

decision: Malaysia and multi-jurisdiction reports (J12)
recommendation_agreed: Hidden until an entity has a Malaysian profile; its rules and formats verified separately before first use

decision: Moving from ledgerline.biz to thapal.in
recommendation_agreed: Keep ledgerline.biz live and untouched; build and preview on thapal.in; after the release gate and your approval, switch users over and leave ledgerline.biz as a permanent redirect
